title: State Faults members form “gloom metal” band Soft Curse, announce debut LP
summary: First single ”Ghost Prism” finds the band toeing the line between stoner doom, prog, classic metal, and melodic emo.

title: Be Your Own Pet announce 20th anniversary tour for debut album
summary: They’ll hit the South and Southwest in July, the West Coast in September, and the Northeast in October.

title: Anxious’ Dante Melucci releases debut EP as The Aether Mod
summary: The Aether Mod is in noticeably different territory, stylistically, from Anxious.

title: Watch Tom Morello (Rage Against the Machine) rally against ICE in NYC ++ pics
summary: Between stops on his current tour performing with Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band, Morello called for people to ”take our power back and adjourn this motherfucking authoritarian clown show once and for all.”

title: Flying Lotus announces full band Blue Note shows in NYC & LA
summary: He released his new EP, ’Big Mama,’ in March.

title: Hovvdy announce new LP ‘Big World’ & tour, share “Try Try Try”
summary: They also have shows with Wilco and Bleachers coming up.

title: Flea brought his ‘Honora’ band to Webster Hall (pics, video, setlist)
summary: They played most of his new jazz album, including his cover of Frank Ocean’s ”Thinkin Bout You.”

title: Alex Cameron announces new album & tour, shares “Red Hook Rain”
summary: ‘Late to Set’ is out July 24 and Alex’s fall tour includes dates opening for The Strokes.

title: Bright Eyes brought out Ben Kweller for “Let’s Not Shit Ourselves” at 1st of 3 Wide Awake/Digital Ash shows
summary: It was the first time they’d played some of the ’Digital Ash in a Digital Urn’ songs in 20 years or more.

title: The Strokes share “Falling Out of Love” from upcoming album
summary: It’s the second single from The Strokes upcoming seventh album ‘Reality Awaits’ which is out June 26.

title: Eartheater announces new album & NYC / LA shows, shares “Paradise Rains”
summary: ’Heavenly Body: If I’m The Bottle You’re The Message’ was produced by Dave Sitek and inspired by the birth of her daughter. It’s out July 14.

title: The Mountain Goats namedrop Layne Staley, Candlebox, Venom & more on new LP ‘Days’ (hear 1st single)
summary: ”This album began life as ’Grunges,’ a sequel to ’Goths,’ after I made a joke on social media about writing a song called ‘Contemplating Pearl Jam in the Carolina Dawn,’” John Darnielle says.
